subject: general
question: Production of silk originated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__.

 
• The **production of silk originates in China** in the **Neolithic** (Yangshao culture, 4th millennium BC).
 
• Silk remained confined to China until the Silk Road opened at some point during the latter half of the first millennium BC.
